PullRequest.Title: chat: remove HydraFusion workflow selection title
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary

- use the Copilot SDK-provided HydraFusion workflow hint instead of locally maintained descriptions
- remove the generated `Selected X workflow` title before creating the chat notification
- keep visual chat, Accessible View, copied content, and restored history consistent
- add focused adapter and renderer coverage

Scenarios.Scenario: Live HydraFusion workflow selection reaches the active chat transcript
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The Copilot SDK emits session.fusion_resolved; CopilotFusionProgress.accept creates one SystemNotificationResponsePart; the existing agent-host state protocol delivers it; systemNotificationToChatPart escapes the selected description; ChatSystemNotificationContentPart synchronously renders it before the row is visible.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Location: src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/copilot/copilotFusionProgress.ts:124-132; transports serialize protocol messages in src/vs/platform/agentHost/browser/agentHostIpcChannelTransport.ts:81 and src/vs/platform/agentHost/browser/webSocketClientTransport.ts:188
ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Serialize and deliver the existing chat response-part update/snapshot containing the workflow notification; the new namespaced metadata carries the SDK hint in addition to content.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One selected notification per distinct fusionId because CopilotFusionProgress._record rejects duplicate route events; no additional protocol call is introduced.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same selection notification crossed the same transport with a locally generated description only in content; no extra transport operation occurred.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The existing state update must arrive before the selection description appears. The diff increases that message by one short workflow-description field but does not add a boundary crossing.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Distinct HydraFusion selections, effectively one selected notification per fusionId; CPU and payload bytes scale linearly with the hint length and number of turns, not with phase count or activity-event frequency.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Fusion events are accepted serially into state; duplicate selections are coalesced by the milestone key. No new parallel task, queue, or burst is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is involved. Both cold and warm live selections perform one conversion and one render; deduplication is stateful per CopilotFusionProgress instance and reset between turns.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence in the one-per-fusion cardinality, existing transport boundary, added metadata bytes, and synchronous render path from direct call-flow evidence.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The SDK type does not establish an explicit hint-length bound in repository code, but the field is a workflow description and test/product examples are short. One duplicate serialized string per selected turn is insufficient for a concrete user-visible regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding. The diff adds bounded serialization/allocation proportional to one short hint but no extra call or fan-out, and replaces the previous title/body renderer path with a single body Markdown render.

Scenarios.Scenario: Opening or reconnecting to a session reconstructs Fusion workflow descriptions from durable/replayed state
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Historical SDK events are replayed serially by mapSessionEvents and FusionReplayState into responseParts; an existing snapshot/update crosses the agent-host protocol; turnsToHistory or activeTurnToProgress scans response parts and systemNotificationToChatPart projects the description before visible history rows render.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch/deliver the existing session snapshot containing completed or active turns and their responseParts.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing snapshot/subscription flow per open or reconnect, containing at most one selected notification for each replayed fusion; no new request is issued per notification.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same turn history and response parts were fetched and scanned; selected notifications retained one localized description in content without a duplicate metadata field.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Snapshot delivery and linear projection are on the history/reconnect path, but the diff changes only bytes in each existing selection record and does not add I/O calls.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of restored turns/fusions and total hint bytes. FusionReplayState scans the event collection serially and CopilotFusionProgress deduplicates each route milestone; effective notification cardinality is one per fusion, not one per replay event.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Replay, turn projection, and response-part iteration are synchronous serial loops. The diff introduces no Promise fan-out, worker, subprocess, or concurrent boundary calls.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No description cache exists or is needed. Reconnect/history reconstruction repeats the existing linear projection; visible row reuse is governed by hasSameContent, which includes the new presentation value and stable description content.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from the replay deduplication, response-part loops, and transport serializers; only the real-world upper bound of SDK hint length is unspecified.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Large histories increase existing snapshot and projection costs, but the incremental metadata is one short duplicate string per selected workflow and the rendering branch performs less work. There is no evidence of large hints or a measurable history-load symptom.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding. Incremental retained/serialized data is linear but small and coalesced per fusion, with no added boundary cardinality or concurrency.

Scenarios.Scenario: Scrolling or rerendering a chat row containing the selected workflow
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The chat list synchronously creates ChatSystemNotificationContentPart for a visible systemNotification and invokes the Markdown renderer to build the row DOM.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of visible/recreated workflow-selection rows and description length; one Markdown render per row after the diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous UI rendering on the chat list render path; no asynchronous work or boundary concurrency.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: hasSameContent permits reuse when content and presentation are unchanged. There is no separate Markdown cache, but the changed branch reduces selected-workflow rendering from separate title and optional body renders to one description render.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from the constructor branches and chatListRenderer call site.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact rerender frequency depends on list virtualization and scrolling, but the direction of changed work is non-regressive: fewer Markdown render calls and fewer DOM elements for normal selected records.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding. The changed visual path removes the title/icon and performs one Markdown render instead of the previous title plus optional body renders.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance review across all 10 changed files and relevant live, replay/history, protocol transport, and UI-render call paths. No high-confidence actionable performance regression was introduced, and there is insufficient evidence to record a shipped regression fix.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
